title: Catarina
goal: Look down at the laguna and be told what you are seeing
culture: From the mirador at Catarina you can see the crater lake, Mombacho, and the town you live in. It is also where Spanish finally makes you use its third distance: este, ese and aquel, that last one for things far enough away to point at.

beats.es: (Doscientos metros abajo hay agua, redonda y quieta.)
beats.good: The Laguna de Apoyo: a crater full of water, two hundred metres below you and about the same again deep.

beats.es: Ahí está. La Laguna de Apoyo.
beats.good: Ahí está — there it is. Two words that hand something over, and you last heard them from the cuidacarros about your moto.

beats.es: Y aquel es el Mombacho. Y aquel de allá, Granada.
beats.en: And that far one is Granada?
beats.good: Aquel is that one over there, further off than ese. Spanish has three distances and this viewpoint is where you finally need the third.

beats.es: Desde aquí se ve todo, joven. Todo.
beats.en: You can see everything from here.
beats.good: From up here you can see the town you live in. It is a strange feeling and a good one, and it is worth the trip on its own.
